result.instructions: Tools for Track-POD, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Track-POD data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run trackpod_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run trackpod_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run trackpod_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. trackpod_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: trackpod_list_orders
tools.title: List orders for a day
tools.description: List the orders of one day — by order date (GET /Order/Date/{date}) or by planned route date (GET /Order/Route/Date/{date}) — with optional filters on delivery status, driver and route number. Track-POD returns the whole day at once; this tool pages it (offset/limit) and reports the total. Times are the account's local times.

date_type.description: order_date (default): orders whose order date is this day, scheduled or not. route_date: orders planned into routes of this day.

status.description: Keep only orders with these delivery statuses: no_status (not yet attempted / unassigned), in_progress (1), not_delivered_site_issue (2), delivered (3, also 'collected'), partially (4), not_delivered_order_issue (5).

driver.description: Keep only orders whose driver login or name contains this text.

route_number.description: Keep only orders on this route number/code.

detail.description: summary (default): key fields per order. full: every field Track-POD returns (goods lines, custom fields, photo links).

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: trackpod_list_orders_changed_since
tools.title: List orders with a recent status change
tools.description: List orders whose delivery status changed after a moment in the last 24 hours (GET /Order/Status/Date/{date-time}; Track-POD accepts no earlier time than UTC now − 1 day). Good for 'what was delivered / failed since this morning'. Paged here (offset/limit).

since.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, within the last 24 hours, e.g. 2026-10-08T06:00:00Z. Default: 23 h 59 min ago.

status.description: Keep only orders with these delivery statuses: no_status (not yet attempted / unassigned), in_progress (1), not_delivered_site_issue (2), delivered (3, also 'collected'), partially (4), not_delivered_order_issue (5).

detail.description: summary (default): key fields per order. full: every field Track-POD returns (goods lines, custom fields, photo links).

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

annotations.title: List orders with a recent status change

tools.name: trackpod_list_route_orders
tools.title: List the orders of a route
tools.description: List the orders on one route, in route order, by route code (GET /Order/Route/Code/{code}). Paged here (offset/limit).

status.description: Keep only orders with these delivery statuses: no_status (not yet attempted / unassigned), in_progress (1), not_delivered_site_issue (2), delivered (3, also 'collected'), partially (4), not_delivered_order_issue (5).

detail.description: summary (default): key fields per order. full: every field Track-POD returns (goods lines, custom fields, photo links).

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

annotations.title: List the orders of a route

tools.name: trackpod_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order with every field: client, address, time slot, goods lines, route, driver, delivery status, ETA, signature/photo links and tracking link. Pass exactly one of number, order_id or track_id (GET /Order/Number|Id|TrackId/{…}). A removed order answers with who removed it (HTTP 410).

number.description: The order number (Order/Invoice/Job/Waybill number), e.g. cv30001-2.

order_id.description: The order Id — the unique identifier from your accounting system that the order was created with.

track_id.description: The order TrackId (UUID) from a tracking link or a webhook.

tools.name: trackpod_find_orders_by_number
tools.title: Find orders by number
tools.description: List the last 25 orders that share one order number (re-deliveries, repeated jobs) — GET /Order/Number/{number}/List. Use it when an order number was reused and trackpod_get_order returns only one of them.

detail.description: summary (default): key fields per order. full: every field Track-POD returns (goods lines, custom fields, photo links).

tools.name: trackpod_get_proof_of_delivery
tools.title: Get proof of delivery
tools.description: Get the electronic proof of delivery (ePOD) of one order: status and status time/GPS, who signed, signature and photo links (valid 24 h), driver comment, reject reasons, delivered vs ordered goods quantities, cash collected, customer feedback and the PDF delivery-note link (ReportUrl, valid 1 h). Pass exactly one of number, order_id or track_id.

number.description: The order number (Order/Invoice/Job/Waybill number), e.g. cv30001-2.

order_id.description: The order Id — the unique identifier from your accounting system that the order was created with.

track_id.description: The order TrackId (UUID) from a tracking link or a webhook.

tools.name: trackpod_list_reject_reasons
tools.title: List reject reasons
tools.description: List the account's reasons for not delivering / not collecting: site, order, goods and scanning issues (GET /RejectReason).

tools.name: trackpod_list_routes
tools.title: List routes for a day
tools.description: List the routes of one day (GET /Route/Date/{date}): code, status (Draft, Ready, Loaded, InProgress, Closed), driver, vehicle, planned vs actual start/finish, distance, cost, current GPS position, and per-route order counts by status. Paged here (offset/limit).

status.description: Keep only routes with these statuses.

include_orders.description: none (default): order counts only. summary: key fields of each order. full: every order field (large).

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: trackpod_get_route
tools.title: Get a route
tools.description: Get one route with its status, driver, vehicle, timings, distance, cost, current GPS position and its orders. Pass exactly one of route_code or route_id (GET /Route/Code|Id/{…}).

route_id.description: The route Id from your accounting system.

include_orders.description: summary (default): key fields of each order. none: counts only. full: every order field.

tools.name: trackpod_get_route_track
tools.title: Get a route's GPS track
tools.description: Get the driver's recorded GPS track of a route (latitude, longitude, speed in m/s, time) — GET /Route/Track/Code|Id/{…}. Pass exactly one of route_code or route_id. Points are paged here (offset/limit, max 1000 per call).

route_id.description: The route Id from your accounting system.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: trackpod_list_drivers
tools.title: List drivers
tools.description: List the account's drivers: name, username, phone, vehicle, depot, zone, teams and active flag (GET /Driver). Paged here.

search.description: Keep only drivers whose name, username, phone or vehicle contains this text.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: trackpod_get_driver
tools.title: Get a driver
tools.description: Get one driver by Track-POD id (UUID) or by username (GET /Driver/Id/{id} or /Driver/Username/{username}). Pass exactly one.

driver_id.description: The driver's Track-POD id (UUID, from trackpod_list_drivers).

tools.name: trackpod_list_vehicles
tools.title: List vehicles
tools.description: List the account's vehicles: plate number, assigned driver, depot, capacity (weight/volume/pallets/size), limits, costs, type and carrier (GET /Vehicle, optional plate-number filter). Paged here.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: trackpod_get_vehicle
tools.title: Get a vehicle
tools.description: Get one vehicle by its Track-POD id (an integer, from trackpod_list_vehicles) — GET /Vehicle/{id}.

tools.name: trackpod_list_vehicle_checks
tools.title: List vehicle checks
tools.description: Driver vehicle inspections (before/after route): checklist items with pass/fail, notes, photo links (valid 24 h), odometer and signature. date only: every check of that day (GET /VehicleCheck/Date/{date}); date + vehicle_number: that vehicle's checks of the day; vehicle_number only: that vehicle's last check (GET /VehicleCheck/{number}).

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: trackpod_create_order
tools.title: Create an order
tools.description: Create ONE REAL unscheduled order in Track-POD (POST /Order): a delivery or a collection for a client at an address, ready to be planned into a route by a dispatcher. It does not create or optimise routes. Depending on the account's notification settings the customer may later receive SMS/e-mail updates about it. Confirm the details with the user first. Address and client are required; Track-POD geocodes the address unless you pass address_lat/address_lon.

number.description: The order number (your Order/Invoice/Job/Waybill number) — used later to look the order up, so no slash or backslash.

address.description: Delivery (or pickup) address, e.g. '2 St Josephs Crescent, Liverpool L3 3JF'.

order_id.description: Your accounting-system id for the order.

depot.description: Depot address (else the account's default depot).

address_lat.description: Address latitude (pass with address_lon to skip geocoding).

time_slot_from.description: Desired delivery/pickup window start, local 24-hour time HH:mm.

time_slot_to.description: Desired delivery/pickup window end, local 24-hour time HH:mm.

service_time_minutes.description: Service time at the stop, minutes.

goods_id.description: Goods id in your accounting system.
